versions.subject: Add proc_creation_win_wmic_remote_command
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: \WMIC.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/node:'
        - process
        - call
        - create 
condition: selection

versions.subject: Updated Rules to Use OriginalFileName
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: \WMIC.exe
    - OriginalFileName|contains: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/node:'
        - process
        - call
        - create
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\WMIC.exe" OR OriginalFileName="*wmic.exe*" CommandLine="*/node:*" CommandLine="*process*" CommandLine="*call*" CommandLine="*create*"
